mobile.session.chip.model_default.note: The model chip when the reader has chosen no model: the computer's configured default is what a start uses. One word, sentence case, no final full stop — it sits in a chip beside the folder name and must stay short enough for a 320 pt row.

mobile.session.chip.model_unknown.note: The model chip when the model list could not be read at all. One word, sentence case, no final full stop: the accessible name carries the explanation. Never renders as a model name.

mobile.session.conversation_details.note: The destination screen's own title, used as the label of the control that opens it — not an action verb. It must stay identical wherever that screen is named, including the sentence in mobile.home.options.fixed, so a reader recognises the same destination. No final full stop.

mobile.session.status_tray.hint.note: Accessibility hint read after the status tray's label. Describes what activating the tray opens; no final full stop. "Subagents" is a product term.

mobile.session.highlights.withheld.note: Quiet line under a highlights block naming deliverables that were refused. {count} counts files; {reasons} is one or more of the withheld_* reason phrases, already translated; when several apply the app joins them pairwise with mobile.session.highlights.withheld_reasons_join. No final full stop.

mobile.session.highlights.withheld_outsi.note: Reason phrase inside mobile.session.highlights.withheld: the file lies outside the folders the app may show. Lower case, no full stop.

mobile.session.highlights.withheld_sensi.note: Reason phrase inside mobile.session.highlights.withheld: the file looks like a credential or secret and is never shown. Lower case, no full stop.

mobile.session.highlights.withheld_missi.note: Reason phrase inside mobile.session.highlights.withheld: the named file was deleted or never written. Lower case, no full stop.

mobile.session.highlights.withheld_too_l.note: Reason phrase inside mobile.session.highlights.withheld: the file exceeds the preview size limit. Lower case, no full stop.

mobile.session.highlights.sound_play.note: Accessibility label of a sound cell's play control. {title} is the sound's own name, copied verbatim. No full stop.

mobile.session.highlights.sound_pause.note: Accessibility label of a sound cell's control while it plays. {title} is the sound's own name. No full stop.

mobile.session.highlights.sound_untitled.note: Stand-in name for a sound with no title, used inside the play/pause labels. One noun.

mobile.session.highlights.video_open.note: Accessibility label of a video tile that starts playback. {name} is the file name, verbatim. No full stop.

mobile.session.highlights.sounds_more.note: Line under the sounds grid when the row held back sounds beyond its bound. {count} counts sounds. No final full stop.

mobile.session.highlights.sound_refused.note: Shown under a sound cell when its bytes could not be fetched. {reason} is the relay's own sentence, passed through untranslated. No final full stop.

mobile.session.highlights.withheld_reaso.note: Joins two reason phrases (or an already-joined list and one more) inside the withheld line. A bare list separator — use your locale's enumeration comma, never a word for "and". Keep both placeholders.

mobile.session.subagent_open.note: Accessibility label of the small `open` control on a subagent's message in the transcript; activating it opens that subagent's own view. {agent} is the subagent's label or job ID exactly as the app shows it, never translated. An imperative verb, no final full stop.

mobile.session.subagent_open_short.note: Visible text of the small control on a subagent's message in the transcript that opens that subagent's own view; screen readers hear mobile.session.subagent_open instead. Shown in lower case beside quiet meta text: keep it one short word, lower case where the script has case, no final full stop.

mobile.session.user_message.show_more.note: Centred control under the reader's own long message in the transcript, which is shown clipped to its first eight lines under a fade; activating it shows the whole message. Also its screen-reader label. Short, sentence case, no final full stop.

mobile.session.user_message.show_less.note: The same control once the reader's long message is shown in full; activating it clips the message back to its first eight lines. Also its screen-reader label. Short, sentence case, no final full stop.

mobile.session.chip.model_resume_hint.note: Accessibility hint on the model chip of an ENDED session: the chip shows the model it last ran with but is disabled, because nothing can change a model until the session is resumed. Imperative, no final full stop.

mobile.session.chip.effort_resume_hint.note: Accessibility hint on the effort (reasoning effort) chip of an ENDED session: shown but disabled until the session is resumed. Use the same word for 'effort' as mobile.home effort copy. Imperative, no final full stop.

mobile.session.chip.model_unrecorded_hin.note: Accessibility hint on the model chip of an ended session when no model was ever recorded; the chip itself shows a dash. A statement, no final full stop.

mobile.session.pending_echo.sending.note: Caption under a message the user just sent, before the computer has acknowledged it. Lower case, trailing ellipsis, no full stop; mirrors the desktop relay's pending row. Must not read as an invitation to send again.

mobile.session.pending_echo.sent.note: Caption under a just-sent prompt once the computer acknowledged it but before the conversation shows it. One lower-case word, no full stop.

mobile.session.pending_echo.queued_step.note: Caption under a steering message the computer accepted while the agent is mid-step: it will be delivered when the current step finishes. Lower case, em dash, no full stop; the TUI's own wording for a queued steer.

mobile.session.pending_echo.queued_next.note: Caption under a steering message the computer accepted after the turn ended: it will ride along with the next message the user sends. Lower case, em dash, no full stop.

mobile.session.pending_echo.images.note: Meta line on a just-sent message saying how many images ride with it; the images themselves are not shown until the conversation carries the message. Sentence fragment, lower case, no full stop.

mobile.session.pending_echo.not_sent.note: Caption, in danger colour, under a message the user sent that the computer definitively refused, kept on screen because the user had already typed something new. Tapping the message puts it back in the message box. Lower case, em dash, no full stop; same register as the other pending_echo captions.

mobile.session.pending_echo.not_confirme.note: Caption, in danger colour, under a message whose delivery is uncertain (the computer did not answer); the Retry button below the message box resends it. Lower case, em dash, no full stop.

Caption, in danger colour, under the first message of a NEW conversation whose start the computer never confirmed. Unlike not_confirmed there is no Retry button on this screen (a start is never resent automatically), so it states the fact only. Lower case, no full stop.

mobile.session.pending_echo.earlier_not_.note: Error line above the message box when an earlier message was refused while the user was already typing the next one: it must be clear the EARLIER message failed, not the text in the box. {reason} is the relay's own short reason, in English. Points at the kept message above, which puts itself back on a tap.

mobile.session.pending_echo.earlier_went.note: Confirmation line above the message box when an earlier message was delivered while the box holds text the user has not sent. Must not claim the text in the box is an edit, and must not say 'delivered' (the message may still be queued).

mobile.session.composer.not_sent_storage.note: Composer error before any HTTP dispatch: local safe-retry preparation failed. The text and image draft has not been consumed. Do not imply uncertain delivery or assert that disk space is the cause; checking free space is one actionable remedy. Never include storage exception text or private paths.

mobile.session.composer.retry_not_sent_s.note: Only the current RETRY ATTEMPT was not dispatched because local safe-retry preparation failed. The original instruction may already have arrived: its separate retained-envelope warning and Retry earlier instruction action stay visible. Never imply the current draft was retried or disk space is the known cause. Never include raw storage errors.

mobile.session.reasoning_disclosure.note: Disclosure label for an assistant reasoning trace, shared by its visible heading and accessibility label. Names the reasoning content, not a live progress status: the same label remains after the turn ends. No preview of reasoning is shown until explicitly expanded. Short noun phrase, no full stop.

mobile.session.history.load.note: Button loads one older durable transcript page, never the whole conversation.

mobile.session.history.loading.note: Busy state while reading one earlier transcript page.

mobile.session.history.failed.note: A transcript page failed or the server explicitly said unavailable; existing visible messages remain. Do not repeat the Try again button's label in this text.

mobile.session.history.refresh_failed.note: Reading the newest transcript page failed (returning to the app, Check again, or reloading history). Shown at the newest edge with a Try again button; do not repeat that label. Must not say EARLIER messages failed.

mobile.session.history.stalled.note: The server returned a cursor that did not advance; automatic reads stop. Name the button's own action (Try again) or reopening; plain wording, no engineering terms.

mobile.session.history.beginning.note: A successful page says no earlier retained rows remain; not a claim that deleted messages exist.

mobile.session.history.empty.note: A successful empty first transcript page; not used for failures or unavailable history.

mobile.session.history.gap.note: Quiet inline row at the actual hole in the transcript, shown only after the automatic gap fill (which runs on every return to the app or reconnect) stopped before reaching the rows below the hole. Nothing is loading when it shows, so it must not say 'loading': it states plainly that some messages are missing from this spot, and the small Load action beside it fetches them. Calm and factual; never says they were lost or deleted, or that the reader did something wrong.

mobile.session.history.gap_newest.note: The same quiet row at the newest edge (under the latest messages), pointing UP at the hole further up the transcript: some messages above are missing. Short; nothing is loading when it shows, and the Load action sits beside it.

mobile.session.history.gap_load.note: Small text action beside the gap row: continues fetching the missing messages from where the automatic fill stopped. One short verb; does not jump away from the reader's position or clear anything.

mobile.session.history.gap_load_hint.note: Screen-reader hint for the Load action: it fetches the messages missed while the phone was disconnected.

mobile.session.sheet_title.model.note: Title of the sheet that lists the models to choose from. Title case in English.

mobile.session.sheet_title.effort.note: Title of the sheet that lists the reasoning-effort levels to choose from. Title case in English.

mobile.session.sheet_title.status.note: Title of the sheet opened from the counts on the activity line above the composer; it lists the conversation's tasks and its sub-agents. Sentence-style capitalisation after the first word in English.

mobile.session.subagent.screen_title.note: Title of the screen that shows one subagent's run. One word; 'subagent' is the product's word for a helper agent started by the main agent.

mobile.session.subagent.prompt_label.note: Lower-case label above the instruction the subagent was given. One word, lower case to match its sibling label.

mobile.session.subagent.result_label.note: Lower-case label above the text the subagent returned. One word, lower case to match its sibling label.

mobile.session.subagent.unavailable_head.note: Empty-state headline on the subagent screen when the computer has no record of it. Sentence with a final full stop.

mobile.session.subagent.unavailable_next.note: Empty-state follow-up giving the two possible reasons the subagent cannot be shown. One sentence.

mobile.session.subagent.no_rows.note: Muted line shown when a subagent's transcript is empty. One sentence.

mobile.session.not_connected.headline.note: Empty-state headline on a session screen opened with no computer connected. Sentence with a final full stop.

mobile.session.not_connected.next.note: Empty-state follow-up telling the user how to reach the session once a computer is connected. One sentence.

mobile.session.empty.headline.note: Empty-state headline for a session with no messages. Short, final full stop.

mobile.session.empty.next.note: Empty-state follow-up pointing to the composer under the transcript. 'Below' refers to the composer's position.

mobile.session.subagents_hint.note: Accessibility hint of the control that reveals the subagents list; read after its name, never drawn. Imperative, no final full stop.

mobile.session.find.label.note: Accessible name of the header find button. Imperative, no final full stop.

mobile.session.find.hint.note: Accessibility hint of the header find button: it searches only the transcript already loaded on the phone. Read aloud, no final full stop.

mobile.session.chip.model_change_failed.note: Inline error under the composer when changing the session's model failed. One short sentence.

mobile.session.chip.effort_change_failed.note: Inline error under the composer when changing the session's effort level failed. 'Effort' is the product's word for how hard the model works.

mobile.session.composer.retained_instruc.note: Notice above the composer when an earlier instruction is retained and may already have been delivered, so the user must retry it before sending the current draft. Two sentences.

mobile.session.tray.context.note: Activity tray fact: how full the model's context window is. {percent} is a whole number; keep the percent sign. Lower case "context".

mobile.session.tray.context_short.note: Short form of the context-window fact. "ctx" is a standard abbreviation of "context"; use the language's own short form. Where the language has no native abbreviation, use the FULL form's wording unchanged rather than leaving the English "ctx": the short form only renders in full-width rows (the More sheet Context row and the status sheet, value cell 318 pt at 390 pt wide), so brevity is not needed. Shipped: es and vi keep the short form a byte-copy of the full form; fr keeps "ctx", which reads as the French abbreviation of "contexte".

mobile.session.tray.context_estimate.note: Context-window fact when the percentage is an estimate. "est." abbreviates "estimated". Keep the parentheses.

mobile.session.tray.context_short_estima.note: Short form of the estimated context-window fact. "ctx" and "est." are abbreviations; keep the parentheses. Same rule as context_short: no English "ctx" left in a language that has no native abbreviation (es and vi reuse the full form).

mobile.session.region.end.note: Cue under the capped activity region when the reader is at its end. Keep the middle dot and the up arrow; lower case.

mobile.session.region.below_labels.note: Cue under the capped activity region naming what is hidden further down. {labels} is a list of region names already joined with the middle dot; keep it unchanged. Keep the down arrow.

mobile.session.region.more_below.note: Cue under the capped activity region when more rows are hidden below and there are no region names to list. Keep the middle dot and the down arrow; lower case.

mobile.session.video.title_fallback.note: Header title of the video screen while the transcript row that names the clip is not loaded yet. One word, Title case if the language uses it.

mobile.session.fallback_name.note: Lower-case noun used as the header title of an untitled session and in "Back to <name>" when the conversation has no name. A bare noun meaning one conversation with the agent.

mobile.session.region.label_working.note: Lower-case noun spliced into mobile.session.region.below_labels {labels} (joined with ' · '): names the 'activity' band that is scrolled out of view. Must read inside 'X below'. Lower case, one word if possible.

mobile.session.region.label_subagents.note: Lower-case noun spliced into {labels} of below_labels: the 'agents' (subagents) band. Reuse the shipped agents/subagents term.

mobile.session.region.label_todos.note: Lower-case noun spliced into {labels} of below_labels: the 'tasks' (todo list) band. Reuse the shipped tasks term.

mobile.session.region.label_strip.note: Lower-case noun spliced into {labels} of below_labels: the status strip band.

mobile.session.back_to.note: Back-navigation label on the video and agent-job screens; {name} is the parent session's own name or the noun phrase from mobile.session.fallback_name ('session') when unknown. Must read grammatically with BOTH (mind case/article: e.g. ru dative). Sentence case, no full stop.

mobile.session.back_to_session.note: Back-navigation label on the video and agent-job screens when the parent session has no name of its own (replaces 'Back to {name}' in that case). Full phrase, sentence case, no full stop; free to adapt article/case/word order. Reuse the locale's 'session' term.
